steps.en: Install the ART client into your agent project
steps.zh: 在你的 agent 项目里装上 ART 客户端

steps.en: Create a TrainableModel and register a backend with it
steps.zh: 创建 TrainableModel 并注册一个后端

steps.en: Run your agent through the model's OpenAI-style client
steps.zh: 用这个模型的 OpenAI 风格客户端跑你的 agent

steps.en: Serves the current LoRA on vLLM and records each rollout as a Trajectory
steps.zh: 用 vLLM 服务当前 LoRA，把每次 rollout 记成一条轨迹

steps.en: Score each trajectory group with RULER
steps.zh: 用 RULER 给每组轨迹打分

steps.en: Runs GRPO, saves the new LoRA, hot-loads it into vLLM, resumes inference
steps.zh: 跑 GRPO、存下新 LoRA、热加载回 vLLM、恢复推理

value.en: Your agent measurably improves on the tasks you really run it on — no labeled trajectories, no hand-written rewards, no training cluster of your own
value.zh: 你的 agent 在真实任务上肉眼可见变强：免标注轨迹、免手写奖励、免自建训练集群
